deck: Trump, Xi and Putin sit at one table in Shenzhen · The World Court finds genocide in Myanmar · COP31 draft drops the fossil-fuel line

head: Three leaders, one table,
and no communiqué
leads.body: Trump, Xi and Putin met in one room for the first time and left without a signed text. Officials described an understanding on shipping lanes and a carbon-market working group; neither side released the wording. The host called the meeting candid, Washington called it useful, and neither word appears in any document.

head: Court finds genocide
in Myanmar
leads.body: Judges voted 109–0 on the provisional finding and ordered the state to preserve evidence and report back within four months. The chamber set no timetable for reparations, which a separate phase will decide.

head: Fossil line dropped
from the draft text
leads.body: The presidency removed the phrase naming fossil fuels and replaced it with "unabated emissions". Adaptation finance held at $120bn a year, below the figure the small-island bloc had asked for.
